items.title: 蚂蚁灵波CEO：具身智能尚未迎来Scaling Law时刻

I head for what I believe to be the brain, tracking my progress on the live X-ray feed.

This could dramatically improve the precision and efficiency of powerful X-ray lasers used in cutting-edge scientific research.

items.summary: 如果“人都会犯错”，那么你可以说机器人是超人。他们比我们更容易出错，即使是在做一些我们可能认为很容易的家务和工厂琐事时也是如此。造成这些错误的原因之一是，机器人很难从过去提取相关细节并实时采取行动，即使使用视觉语言模型（VLM）来解释视频和图像等视觉输入以及自然语言也是如此。
items.summary_original: If "to err is human," you could say robots are superhuman. They're more error-prone than we are, even when tasked with things like home and factory chores, which we might consider easy. One reason for these mistakes is that robots struggle to extract relevant details from the past and act on them in real time, even with vision-language models (VLMs), which interpret visual inputs such as videos and images along with natural language.
